results.title: LIVE UPDATES: 49th ASEAN Summit in Manila
results.content: Leaders and representatives of the 11 members of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations, and their allies, are gathering in Manila for the bloc's biggest event of the year

results.title: Police arrest anti-Pax Silica protesters as ASEAN Summit opens in Manila
results.content: At least 11 protesters were arrested by police within the freedom park, according to Manila Police District Spokesperson Philip Ines

results.title: Canada’s Carney visits Manila Cathedral, Fort Santiago after Marcos meeting
results.content: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney, a devout Catholic, is given 'a glimpse of the rich history, faith, and cultural heritage of the Filipino people,' according to a social media post of the Manila Cathedral
